عَنِيدٌ : see عَنُودٌ, first sentence. ―
-b2- A man who deviates, or declines, from obedience to God. (L.) One who opposes and rejects what is true, or just, knowing it to be so; [who acts obstinately, knowing a thing and rejecting it, or declining from it; (see 1;)] as also ↓ عَانِدٌ , (S, Mgh, * O, L, K,) and ↓ عَنُودٌ , (O, L, TA,) and ↓ مُعَانِدٌ . (A.) One who oversteps, or transgresses, the proper bound, or limit; who acts exorbitantly, or immoderately; and especially in disobedience, or rebellion; as also ↓ عَانِدٌ . (L.) The pl. of عَنِيدٌ is عُنُدٌ. (O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
